title: A leaner text model catalog
summary:
A catalog trim, a corrected Python example, and some tidying in the community project directory.

The text model list dropped llamalight, llama-vision, llama-scaleway, and pixtral. Mistral remains an option for text-and-image input, while Sur and Unity remain in the catalog.

The website’s image-generation example now creates a `pollinations.Image` with the chosen model, dimensions, and seed, then calls `Generate(prompt=..., save=True)`.

VibeCoder moved into Tools & Interfaces, and the Indonesian-language Generator Text AI joined the creative applications list.
